description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git's rename and copy detection features. It sets up reference and working trees, performs diffs, and validates the output to verify the detection of renames and copies within a Git repository.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, executing the provided commands.

methods.name: git update-index
methods.description: Adds or removes files from the index to prepare for diff operations.

methods.name: git write-tree
methods.description: Creates a new tree object from the current index state.

methods.name: git diff-index
methods.description: Performs diff between the working tree and the index, with options to detect copies and renames.

methods.name: compare_diff_patch
methods.description: Compares two diff outputs to verify they match expected patterns.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.
